HUNTAWAY All-Terrain Lightweight Aluminum Kids Mountain Bike - 20" & 24"
Get your young riders ready for every trail with the HUNTAWAY All-Terrain Kids Mountain Bike. Designed with a lightweight aluminum frame, front suspension fork, and reliable 7-speed drivetrain, this bicycle gives kids aged 7 to 12 the confidence to conquer neighborhood streets, gravel paths, and rugged mountain trails.

HUNTAWAY All-Terrain Kids Mountain Bike: Engineered for comfort, control, and performance on every trail.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Built to bite into dirt and loose gravel, balancing rolling speed and grip for total control on every ride."
Trail-Ready Components
Engineered for safety and maximum agility, the HUNTAWAY features a high-strength lightweight aluminum frame that stays easy for kids to handle. The front suspension fork absorbs trail impacts to keep rides smooth over rough bumps and rocks.

Shock-absorbing front suspension fork paired with front and rear disc brakes for all-weather safety.

Key Engineering Highlights

Lightweight Aluminum Frame: Maximizes maneuverability and durability while reducing total bike weight.

Shimano 7-Speed Drivetrain: Equipped with a smooth Shimano rear derailleur and intuitive twist shifter for effortless hill climbing.

Dual Mechanical Disc Brakes: Front and rear disc brakes deliver powerful, reliable stopping force across all weather and road conditions.

20" x 1.95" Trail-Grabbing Tires: All-terrain knobby tread provides superior traction, low rolling resistance, and puncture protection.

Convenience & Customization: Features a tool-free quick-release seat post, double water bottle cage mounts, front/rear mudguards, and a sturdy rear kickstand.

Size Chart & Fit Guide
Choose the perfect size for your growing rider. The HUNTAWAY mountain bike comes in 20-inch and 24-inch wheel options.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Get onto the trails without delay! The HUNTAWAY kids bike arrives 85% pre-assembled out of the box. All essential tools and step-by-step instructions are provided for quick assembly in under 30 minutes.

<>
Assembly Video: Step-by-step setup guide to assemble your HUNTAWAY bike quickly and securely.

See It In Action
Watch how the HUNTAWAY handles all types of terrain—from flat city roads to off-road gravel and mountain paths.

Riding Video: High-performance control, smooth gear transitions, and superior trail handling in real conditions.

Included Accessories: Tool-free quick-release seat collar, double bottle cage mounts, front and rear mudguards, rear-mounted kickstand, and safety reflectors

Our Guarantee
We stand behind the quality of our bicycles. Every HUNTAWAY mountain bike is backed by our Limited Lifetime Warranty on the aluminum frame and a 1-year warranty on all drivetrain and braking components.
